name: Azulongmon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] Trash 1 digivolution card from the bottom of all of your opponent's Digimon. Then, gain 1 memory for each of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards.
[Your Turn] For each Digimon with no digivolution cards your opponent has in play, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
